text_block_list.text:
Apr △, Noon | Wind: Gentle "Once We're on 
Land, We're Pals, Right?" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The Navigator's plan was a massive hit! I 
managed to defeat Air Shakur and claim the 
treasure known as the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We voyaged through a fierce race together, 
so naturally Shakur was supposed to become 
my crewmate. Disappointing! It wasn't 
meant to be.
